added.summary: `loudness <lufs>` normalises a video's sound to that integrated loudness with ffmpeg's loudnorm (EBU R128), −16 to 0 (typically −16 for streaming, −14 louder), so clips a generative model made at different levels all play at one target; off by default.
`aiGenerated true` marks footage made by a generative model; VideoInfo.aiGenerated carries it, so a game or store labels AI content.

`og video edges <path> [--out <dir>]` writes the first and last frame of a clip as PNG (`<stem>.first.png`, `<stem>.last.png`): the last frame is the seed an image-to-video model continues from for the next clip, the first checks a cut joins. `path` is a media file or a `type video` .ogt (whose source and maxSeconds it reads).
